svg.title: Dreams function review: Verified names: 0.13% (12/9,551)
svg.desc: 9,551 discovered functions grouped in fixed 1 MiB address regions. 12 verified names are green; 4 reviewed but unresolved are amber; 9,535 unreviewed functions are gray. Regions are not identified subsystems. Pseudocode generation does not count as a verified name or complete function correctness.

g.text: One tile = one discovered function. Block size = function count in that address region.
Green verifies a descriptive name; it does not mean original source recovery or complete behavioral understanding.
